messages.english: Review seed allocations and planned pack counts.
messages.translation: Kambela miavelo ya mbewu na tinhlayo ta mapakete lama kunguhatiweke.
Kambela ku kumiwa ka mbewu loku kunguhatiweke

messages.english: Crop planner → Nursery requirements → Seed sourcing
messages.translation: Mupulani wa swibyariwa → Swilaveko swa xirhapa xo kurisa swimilana → Ku kumiwa ka mbewu

messages.english: Open the nursery review for saved planned batches, add the batches that can share a seed supply, and enter your allocation and seeds per pack. Review the planned requirements before downloading the CSV. Blank counts stay unknown; these inputs do not record seed stock, place an order or cover all farm seed demand.
messages.translation: Pfula nkambelo wa xirhapa xo kurisa swimilana wa mintlawa leyi kunguhatiweke leyi hlayisiweke, engetela mintlawa leyi nga avelanaka mphakelo wa mbewu, kutani u nghenisa xiavelo xa wena na timbewu eka pakete yin’wana na yin’wana. Kambela swilaveko leswi kunguhatiweke emahlweni ko kopa CSV. Tinhlayo leti nga hava nchumu ti tshama ti nga tiviwi; leswi nghenisiweke a swi rhekhodi xitoko xa mbewu, a swi veki odara kumbe ku hlanganisa xilaveko hinkwaxo xa mbewu ya purasi.
